forecast-period.text: A high pressure system centred over the Tasman Sea extends a ridge westwards over central and eastern SA and a low pressure trough extends from WA over western SA. This trough will be very slow-moving for the rest of this week and over the weekend and the ridge will move away to the east. A weakening cold front will slip across southern coasts late Thursday and early Friday.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Isolated showers and possible thunderstorms in the far southwest and isolated showers near southern and western coasts. Maximum temperatures well above average. Northeast to northwesterly winds ahead of a southwest to southeasterly change in the west.
Isolated showers in the far southwest. Southeast to northeasterly winds ahead of a southwest to southeasterly change in the far southwest.

Isolated showers in the far southwest and about western and southern coastal areas. Chance of an afternoon thunderstorm in the far southwest, about Eyre and Yorke Peninsulas and Kangaroo Island. Maximum temperatures well above average. Northeast to northwesterly winds, tending fresh at times in the north, turning southwest to southeasterly about western and southern districts.

text.p: Isolated showers and possible thunderstorms in the far west and isolated shower about southern coastal areas. Maximum temperatures near average about southern coastal areas but well above average inland. Northeast to northwesterly winds, fresh at times in the north, tending southwest to southeasterly about western and southern parts.

Dry apart from the chance of an isolated shower or thunderstorm about central and eastern parts of the southern agricultural area and near the western border. Maximum temperatures mostly well above average inland. Northeast to southeasterly winds, fresh at times in the west and near the coast.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Sunday: generally less than 2 mm about the far southwest and southern and western coastal areas, but local falls of 2 to 10 mm are possible. Isolated falls of 10 to 20 mm are possible about the far southwest, Kangaroo Island and the Lower South East.
